macros.name: clockwise
macros.doc: The command \clockwise sets the following rotations to be clockwise for positive angles.

macros.name: counterclockwise
macros.doc: The command \counterclockwise sets the following rotations to be counterclockwise for positive angles.

macros.name: rotcaption
macros.doc: The command \rotcaption is analogous to the normal \caption command, and inserts the caption rotated by 90 degrees.

envs.name: rotate
envs.doc: The \begin{rotate}{<angle>} environment rotates the contents by the given number of degrees in the direction specified by the most recent of the \clockwise or \counterclockwise commands, but no arrangements are made for leaving space for the result.

envs.name: sideways
envs.doc: The sideways environment rotates the contents of the environment by 90 degrees counterclockwise, and leaves space for the result.

envs.name: turn
envs.doc: The \begin{turn}{<angle>} environment rotates the contents by the given number of degrees in the direction specified by the most recent of the \clockwise or \counterclockwise commands, leaving space for the result.
